access.description: Send requests through the Grafana server.

basicAuth.description: Enable HTTP Basic authentication. When enabled, the SDK populates `httpclient.Options.BasicAuth` from `basicAuthUser` / `secureJsonData.basicAuthPassword`.

basicAuthUser.description: Username sent with HTTP basic authentication.

database.description: Fallback database name for existing configurations without jsonData.dbName.

dbName.description: Database to query with InfluxQL or Flight SQL. For InfluxQL on 2.x, use the database name in the DBRP mapping.

defaultBucket.description: Bucket used by the v.defaultBucket macro in Flux queries.

enableSecureSocksProxy.description: Route connections through the secure SOCKS proxy configured on the Grafana server.

httpHeaders.description: Headers sent with HTTP requests. Store each name in jsonData.httpHeaderName<N> and its value in secureJsonData.httpHeaderValue<N>, starting at 1.

httpMode.description: HTTP method used for InfluxQL queries. POST carries the query in the request body.

insecureGrpc.description: Use plaintext gRPC to connect to a Flight SQL server.

keepCookies.description: Cookies, by name, that the Grafana proxy should forward to the datasource. The Grafana proxy strips all cookies by default.

maxSeries.description: Maximum number of series or tables returned by a Flux query. Use a whole number. Zero uses the default of 1000.

oauthPassThru.description: Forward the signed-in user’s OAuth identity on HTTP requests. For OAuth-only authentication, omit the database user and password.

organization.description: Organization required for every Flux connection, including InfluxDB 1.8. Flux queries also use it for the v.organization macro.

pdcInjected.description: Grafana sets this flag to show the Private Data Source Connect entry in the settings sidebar.

product.description: InfluxDB product used to select the available query languages. The editor can identify it from the URL or the server response.

secureSocksProxyUsername.description: SOCKS5 username. Defaults to the data source UID. For a Grafana Cloud PDC agent, use the ID of the private network selected from the networks in your stack.

serverName.description: Server name used to verify the certificate on HTTP connections.

showTagTime.description: Time range applied to InfluxQL tag autocomplete queries.

timeInterval.description: Lower limit for the automatic query interval, such as 10s.

timeout.description: Timeout in whole seconds for HTTP requests and for connecting to the secure SOCKS proxy.

tlsAuth.description: Present a client certificate on HTTP connections.

tlsAuthWithCACert.description: Trust a custom certificate authority for TLS connections.

tlsSkipVerify.description: Skip verification of the server certificate for HTTP requests.

version.description: Query language to use for this data source. Defaults to InfluxQL when omitted.

url.description: Base URL of the InfluxDB server. For SQL, include the Flight SQL port if it differs from 443.

user.description: Database username for InfluxQL password authentication. It also enables HTTP Basic fallback when no OAuth token is forwarded. Omit it for OAuth-only or unauthenticated connections.

withCredentials.description: Whether credentials such as cookies or auth headers should be sent with cross-site requests.

secureValues.description: Password sent with HTTP basic authentication.
PEM-encoded CA certificate used to verify the server certificate.
PEM-encoded client certificate sent to the HTTP server.
PEM-encoded private key for the HTTP client certificate.
Password paired with the InfluxQL database user. Omit it for OAuth-only or unauthenticated connections.

Required for Flux. Use an API token on InfluxDB 2.x or username:password on 1.8. Flight SQL sends the token as a Bearer credential. The SQL editor requires a token when validation is enabled. Provisioning can omit it if the server allows unauthenticated connections.
SOCKS5 password if the proxy requires one. Omit it for a PDC agent network.
